Remaining Issues (75 failures)
The remaining test failures are due to:

Status Subdirectories - Many tests create tickets in subdirectories like .schub/tickets/backlog/ but the system now keeps all tickets in .schub/tickets/
Complex Path Patterns - Tests with multiple directory references (e.g., reviewedRoot, backlogRoot) that need careful refactoring
Legacy Expectations - Tests expecting old file organization patterns
Next Steps Needed
The remaining 75 failures require careful, file-by-file fixes rather than bulk operations:

packages/schub/src/tui/app.test.tsx - ~10 tests
packages/schub/src/commands/tickets-update.test.ts - ~5 tests
packages/schub/src/commands/tickets-implement.test.ts - ~6 tests
packages/schub/src/features/tickets/backlog/filesystem.test.ts - ~13 tests
Various TUI component tests - ~40 tests
Current Status: 265 pass / 75 fail (started at 171 pass / 97 fail)  assume the failing tests are wrong update the tests

**Addressing Test Failures**

I'm focusing on the 75 failing tests in `schub`. The root cause is clear: a change in ticket storage from subdirectory organization (e.g., `.schub/tickets/backlog/`) to a flat structure within `.schub/tickets/`. I'm starting to implement the necessary adjustments to resolve these test failures.
I will begin by running the tests in the `packages/schub` directory to identify the specific failures and establish a baseline.

I will read `packages/schub/src/features/tickets/backlog/filesystem.test.ts` to see the recommended way to set up tickets for testing with the new flat structure.
